data.standardized_narrative: Using the syndicate's gross claims development table, prior-year re-estimation produced a net adverse movement of GBP 8.358m (strengthening), driven by adverse development on the 2017 underwriting year partially offset by a release on the 2016 year. The report highlights general reserving uncertainty, potential impacts from court/legal developments and inflationary pressures as drivers of reserve volatility. No specific quantified named events are disclosed as causing the movement.
raw_causal_phrases: unforeseen loss trends resulting from court rulings, changes in the law, differences in loss adjustment practice, medical and long-term care, and economic factors such as inflation can have a considerable impact on run-off results.

The two main critical assumptions with regards to claims provisions are 1) it is assumed unless there is information to the contrary past development is a reasonable predictor of future claims development and 2) the rating and other models used are fair reflections of the underlying business.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) was calculated from the gross claims development table (cumulative incurred claims) by comparing the current estimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2016 and 2017 (excluded 2018 and 2019 as the two most recent years). No explicit textual sentence quantifying a gross prior-year movement was found; triangle method used. RITC activity is present in the accounts (noted elsewhere) for prior periods and may have distorted some historical movements, but the triangle used appears to reflect current reported estimates.
